extractor.prompt: Extract founding relations in Heidegger's Sein und Zeit, focusing on how theoretical knowledge is founded in practical being-in-the-world, how individual equipment is founded in equipmental totalities, how reference-structures are founded in worldhood, and how all comportment is founded in care.
extractor.note: Partial extraction covering §§13, 15, 18, and 41 on the founding of knowing in being-in-the-world, equipment in equipmental wholes, involvement in world-familiarity, and being-in-the-world in care. Focuses on: (1) theoretical knowing as a founded mode of being-in; (2) individual tools presupposing equipmental totality; (3) reference and involvement grounded in significance and worldhood; (4) worldhood grounded in Dasein's for-the-sake-of-which; (5) all comportments founded in care-structure. Not covered: detailed treatment of falling (§§35-38), mood and understanding (§§29-31), authentic/inauthentic distinction throughout, or care's temporalization (§69).

coverage_note: Extracts from sections 13, 15, 18, and 41 which contain explicit treatment of founded structures: knowing founded in being-in, equipment founded in totality, involvement founded in worldhood, and all being founded in care. Focuses on the asymmetric dependence relationships constitutive of Dasein's being-in-the-world.

units.claim: Knowing is antecedently grounded in an already-being-alongside-the-world; it is a mode of Dasein founded in being-in-the-world, not a primary access that creates a subject-object relation.
units.quote: knowing is antecedently grounded in an already-being-alongside-the-world (Schon-sein-bei-der-Welt)

units.claim: Knowing wins a new stance of being toward the world, but this founded possibility develops only on the ground of the already-discovered being-in-the-world of concern.
units.quote: knowing is a mode of Dasein founded in being-in-the-world

units.claim: Strictly taken, an equipment never is in isolation; to the being of equipment there always belongs an equipmental whole, within which it can be the specific equipment that it is.
units.quote: Strictly taken, an equipment never "is"; to the being of equipment there always belongs an equipmental whole (Zeugganzes)

units.claim: Before any individual item of equipment is encountered, an equipmental totality is in each case already discovered; the item is accessible only as what it is within the foundational whole.
units.quote: Before this individual item, an equipmental totality is in each case already discovered

units.term: Involvement as foundational mode of being
units.claim: Involvement is the ontologically foundational character of the ready-to-hand, on which reference-structures and suitabilities are in turn founded; properties of beings are bound within suitabilities, which are bound within serviceability.
units.quote: Serviceability (reference) as equipment-constitution, however, is no suitability of a being either, but the being-level condition of the possibility of its being determined by suitabilities

units.claim: Individual involvement is discovered only on the ground of the pre-discoveredness of an involvement-totality; every encountered ready-to-hand pre-discovers the worldly character of the world.
units.quote: Involvement itself, as the being of the ready-to-hand, is in each case discovered only on the ground of the pre-discoveredness of an involvement-totality

units.claim: The involvement-totality regresses to a primary what-for at which there is no further involvement, which is itself a possibility of Dasein's being whose constitution includes worldhood.
units.quote: the involvement-totality itself goes back ultimately to a what-for at which there is no further involvement — which is itself not a being of the ready-to-hand's mode of being within a world, but a being whose being is determined as being-in-the-world

units.claim: Care, as the original structural totality of Dasein's being-in-the-world, lies existentially a priori before every factical comportment; both theoretical and practical modes of being are founded in care.
units.quote: Care, as original structural totality, lies existentially-a priori "before" every factical "comportment" and "situation" of Dasein
